work_en: Treasury of Blessings: Liturgy of the Buddha Śākyamuni

work_en: Praise of the Twelve Deeds of the Buddha ('Thub rnams spangs rtogs ma')
notes: Composed at the Potala by 'Za hor gyi bande' (5th Dalai Lama); modelled on the twelve-deeds praise attributed to Nāgārjuna.

work_en: Fierce Rite of Slaying the Target by Lightning (Vajravidāraṇa cycle)

work_en: Twenty Verses on the Great Vehicle
notes: Translated by Candrakumāra and Śākya 'od.

work_en: Compendium of the Great Vehicle
notes: Translated by Jinamitra, Śīlendrabodhi and Ye shes sde.

work_en: Explanation of the Compendium of the Great Vehicle

work_en: Ornament of the Mahāyāna Sūtras
notes: One of Maitreya's five treatises; translated by Śākyasiṃha and dPal brtsegs, revised by rNgog Blo ldan shes rab.
metadata_issues: Category 'Middle Way' for a Yogācāra (Mind-only) treatise.

work_en: Sublime Continuum of the Great Vehicle (Uttaratantra)

work_en: Treatise on the Gateway to Understanding the Hundred Dharmas of the Great Vehicle

work_en: Mahāyāna Mind Training: The Wheel of Sharp Weapons

work_en: Summary of the Means of Accomplishing the Mahāyāna Path

notes: Translated by Atiśa himself and dGe ba'i blo gros.

work_en: Prayer Virtuous in the Beginning, Middle and End (Thog mtha' ma)

work_en: Praise of the Three Jewels

work_en: Rite of the Maṇḍala Lines

work_en: Sūtra of Nanda's Going Forth

work_en: Praise of Ārya Avalokiteśvara by Bhikṣuṇī Lakṣmī ('Po bstod')

work_en: Supplement to the Single Intention (dGongs gcig)

work_en: Explanation of the Sūtra Unravelling the Intent

work_en: Purifying Entities

work_en: Lamp that Generates Faith

work_en: Sādhana of Ekavīra (Heruka)

work_en: Sādhana of Lokeśvara according to the Guhyasamāja

work_en: Sādhana of Glorious Vajrayoginī
